body:
## Type

Enhancement to replay qualification tooling. Server runtime behavior is unchanged.

## Linked issue

Advances #1271, with the existing SQL mode and transaction-authority contracts tracked by #1279 and #1290. These broader issues remain open.

## Summary

Separate apply, duplicate, and metadata-only no-op replay workloads; add complete row/title/checkpoint verification before and after clean local reopen. Keep SQL default and replayable transaction lanes separate from replay-API ledger semantics.

## User/operator impact

Operators can reproduce matched indexed/unindexed replay and embedded SQL experiments, identify the actual primary policy, and distinguish successful acknowledgements from verified clean recovery.

## Current and expected behavior

Duplicate/no-op fixtures seed the same dataset before measurement. Reports distinguish submitted/applied events, retain foreground commit attribution, and explicitly label constructor/startup recovery after clean shutdown. No-op is not a zero-I/O promise. SQL lanes reject ledger-only duplicate/no-op selection.

## Scope

Replay benchmark, focused selector/verifier controls, owning contract documentation, and generated inventories. Uses published Midge 0.5.2 unchanged; CI/release/version configuration is unchanged. Query verification uses the fixed 64 MiB analytical benchmark budget on the original instance and reopen; production defaults remain unchanged.

## Evidence and support status

Final head: c5b592958409a2d599bb0771838db7ddb18c6d95.

- Source/Jev review accepted the bounded verifier and exact counters/recovery boundaries. An adversarial verifier gap of 0.36 led to executable short/extra/wrong/null rejection controls, all passing.
- Earlier 10 MiB and 64 MiB attempts failed the filtered aggregate verification path with 54000. The verifier now reads each title bucket through a bounded projected equality query and checks every returned title and exact cardinality; the independent total count and checkpoint/reopen assertions remain.
- New regressions were authored before their implementation; no unobserved baseline RED is claimed.
- Both indexed and unindexed strict 100k apply/reopen controls passed on this head. All 16/16 small lanes passed. 13/16 repeated 100k apply lanes passed; the second unindexed SQL-default repeat failed title-10 verification with SQLSTATE 57014 (query timeout exceeded), and the final buffered/strict unindexed repeats were not run after that failure.
- Results are local diagnostics with uncontrolled host activity. Clean reopen is not process-kill, power-loss, cloud-loss, or production qualification. Eleven inherited missing inventory records are reconciled separately from the new controls.

## Validation

- `cargo build --locked --bin cassie`: passed in the owned worktree.
- Complete `cargo test --locked`: 14,355 passed, zero failed, nine inherited ignores at 40e4c23d. Subsequent changes affect benchmark/test tooling, not production implementation.
- Final affected `cargo test --locked --test bench_diagnostics`: 13 passed, including all four invalid-bucket controls.
- `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -D clippy::pedantic`: passed on the final head.
- `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cntryl-tools validate-tests -f tests/bench_diagnostics/replay_mode.rs`, and pinned generated-inventory check: passed on the final head.
- Instrumented benchmark build with `--profile test`: passed. Actual workload/recovery matrix stopped after the SQLSTATE 57014 verification failure: 2 targeted and 16 smoke lanes passed; 13 large repeats passed, 1 failed, 2 were not run.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Distinct workload selection and exact event-count reporting.
- [x] Reject invalid verifier output without reducing assertions or raising production limits.
- [x] Source review and affected local checks completed.
- [x] Indexed and unindexed strict 100k acknowledgement and clean-reopen controls passed.
- [x] All 16/16 small apply/duplicate/no-op lanes passed.
- [ ] Complete all 16 repeated 100k apply lanes (13 passed, 1 verification timeout, 2 not run).
- [ ] Broader #1271 crash/cloud/production qualification remains open.

## Status

Draft: the large matrix has a verified query-timeout failure and two unrun repeats. Main advanced through #1330 (`62f14515`), so this older head currently conflicts in generated inventories. Reviewed integration `747ffc7a` on the new main is prepared with byte-identical replay benchmark, production sources and lockfile. The frozen matrix has stopped. Integrated 747ffc7a passed build, all 19 focused tests, full strict Clippy, format, test policy, inventory and instrumented benchmark build. One focused compilation was interrupted by tool-runtime replacement/SIGTERM; its same-head retry passed. A separately reviewed benchmark-only 120-second fixture profile is prepared for the failed and remaining controls; those results will stay separate from the original 30-second matrix. The runtime bundle full gate is running first, then the deadline repair gets affected checks before the final explicit lease update. Measurements retain their actual `c5b59295` source identity. The original c5b59295 hosted backend and available CodeQL checks passed; the pending integrated head will require fresh hosted checks. No merge is requested.
title: Enhancement: Separate replay workloads and verify clean recovery
